title: dev-browser-observe series plan: fresh sessions of two (or more) variant profiles in a declared order

protocol.description: timing-abba.v1: order X,Y,Y,X, every op repeat { warmups: 2, measured: 10 }, ops edit-body, edit-shared-component, edit-managed-css, edit-title, edit-category. resource-study.v1: each profile declares resourceStudy with the protocol constants.

variants.description: Variant name -> { profile }. Profiles must be equal except buildReceipt, productSha, productDirtyIdentity and description, and share outDir and lock. For A/A, use two receipts of the same binary.

declaredDifferences.description: Identity facets allowed to differ between variants (default none: an A/A series).

labelPrefix.description: Session labels are <labelPrefix>-s<n>-<variant>; the series record is <outDir>/<labelPrefix>.series.json.

scenarios.description: Scenario ids passed to every session as --scenario (default: all).
